renderer: Native WebGL 1; no third-party runtime libraries or paid services
units: Consistent scene units; object dimensions are never animated

geometry.warehouse: Procedural cutaway warehouse, shelves, packing arm and conveyor
geometry.parcel: One persistent hollow box and hinged lid, using the existing parcel texture
geometry.aircraft: Unbranded navy aircraft, cargo opening, hinged door and retractable landing gear
geometry.ocean: One continuous ocean surface between physical coastlines, with scroll-dependent water and clouds
geometry.customs: Handling trolley, scanner, sorting belt and loading platform
geometry.truck: Navy truck, rear doors, cabin door, rotating and steering wheels
geometry.home: Cream facade, navy roof, visible front door and doorstep
geometry.courier: Articulated courier with distance-driven walking, parcel pickup, placement and departure

settings.durations_status: Illustrative and editable; not verified delivery promises

asset_policy: Existing approved logo is copied unchanged. The parcel lid retains the existing package artwork. References guide procedural 3D models; the image sprites are not animated as scene substitutes.
